answer.explanation: From 11:32 to 11:42 UTC, CrudApiFunction repeatedly failed with AccessDeniedException on dynamodb:PutItem against CartTable ("no identity-based policy allows the dynamodb:PutItem action"). The IaC template grants dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:Query to CrudApiRole. The live inline policy app-policy on that role grants only dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:Query, so PutItem was removed outside the template. The live function configuration (memory, timeout, environment, concurrency) matches the IaC, so this is not a CONFIG issue. CompressionFunction's LastModified (11:21:47) is before the window and its configuration matches the IaC.
